terminal.credit.tipOnTime: - Pay every installment on time: payment history is the biggest factor (35%%).
terminal.credit.tipLate: - A payment 30+ days late is reported and stays 7 years; 60, 90 and 120 days late hurt progressively more.
terminal.credit.tipInquiries: - Every loan application is a hard inquiry (counts 12 months). Same-type applications within 45 days count once.
terminal.credit.tipAge: - New accounts lower the average age of your history; old accounts help, even after they are closed.
terminal.credit.tipBalance: - Paying loans down lowers the balance-to-original ratio (30%% of the score).
terminal.credit.tipUtilization: - Keep your credit line balance under 30%% of its limit (1-10%% is best). Utilization has no memory: pay it down and the score recovers at the next report.
terminal.credit.tipPayoff: - Taking a loan and repaying it at once does not build credit: it adds an inquiry and a young account, but no months of on-time payments.
terminal.credit.tipMix: - Handling both installment loans and a revolving credit line improves the credit mix; different kinds of loans (personal, business, sovereign) help a little more.
